name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: Displays file media, metadata, caller-owned upload state, and actions.

motionProfile.reason: Progress feedback stays within the attachment; it introduces no upload state or surface choreography.

data.transition/continuous.reason: Attachment integrates the existing content/data/status phase at its own parts, using the reached installed executor.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: Attachment mounts button for press feedback; that installed component remains the integration owner.
